notes: NEX Debugger Evidence Specialist · Phase 5 IMPLEMENTATION contract · founder-authorised 2026-09-12. Constitutional purpose (locked): 'Find reproducible causal explanations for observed software failures without claiming certainty beyond the evidence.' Advisory. Deterministic. Never executes. Never mutates code. Never self-promotes into NEX1.
constitutional_purpose_locked_2026_09_12: Find reproducible causal explanations for observed software failures without claiming certainty beyond the evidence. Symptom ≠ Cause. Cause-unknown is a first-class successful outcome.

state_model_boundary.statement: Debugger uses its own outcome vocabulary. It does NOT reuse Evidence Engine PASSED/FAILED and does NOT introduce a new numeric confidence family. Only the six ordinal outcomes are permitted.

outcomes_permitted.REPRODUCED: Failure reproduced deterministically · root-cause analysis not yet reached a determination · not a positive verdict on cause
outcomes_permitted.ROOT_CAUSE_SUPPORTED: Failure reproduced AND SBFL top-ranked location intersects with AST-diff churn set AND minimised repro confirms the location · strongest evidence tier available in v0.1.0
outcomes_permitted.ROOT_CAUSE_PLAUSIBLE: Failure reproduced AND SBFL has a top candidate BUT AST-diff does not intersect OR minimised repro does not confirm · weaker evidence tier · NEX3 may still request more evidence
outcomes_permitted.ROOT_CAUSE_UNRESOLVED: Failure reproduced AND no single candidate cause emerges from SBFL/AST-diff intersection · FIRST-CLASS SUCCESSFUL OUTCOME · not a failure of the specialist · honest verdict when evidence does not support a determination
outcomes_permitted.NOT_REPRODUCIBLE: Reproduction attempts do not yield the failure across seeded runs · FIRST-CLASS SUCCESSFUL OUTCOME · honest verdict
outcomes_permitted.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: Reproduction fixture broken · no coverage data · missing inputs · malformed observation record · specialist cannot proceed responsibly

failure_timeline_shape.input_hash: sha256 prefix of the failing input
failure_timeline_shape.seed: deterministic PRNG seed used across the session
failure_timeline_shape.steps: array of { step_index · operation · state_before_hash · state_after_hash · diff_from_expected? · notes? }
failure_timeline_shape.first_divergence: { step_index · expected_state_hash · actual_state_hash · diff_description } OR null when no expected-state baseline supplied

sbfl_formulas_permitted.ochiai: |e_f| / sqrt((|e_f| + |n_f|) * (|e_f| + |e_p|))  · literature-named · NOT a fabricated quality score

sbfl_result_fields.name: ranking
sbfl_result_fields.shape: array of { location · path · line · suspicion } · sorted descending by suspicion

ast_diff_fields.name: churned_nodes
ast_diff_fields.shape: array of { path · syntax_kind · line_start · line_end · churn_class: added|removed|modified }

root_cause_candidate_fields.name: evidence_ids
root_cause_candidate_fields.shape: array of string · MUST include at least one SBFL evidence_id AND at least one AST-diff evidence_id for ROOT_CAUSE_SUPPORTED · ROOT_CAUSE_PLAUSIBLE relaxes this to any one authoritative source

root_cause_candidate_fields.name: symptom_frame
root_cause_candidate_fields.shape: { file · line · stack_hash } · the surface site where the failure was observed · distinguished from cause location

root_cause_candidate_fields.name: confidence_class
root_cause_candidate_fields.shape: one of ['strong','plausible','weak','insufficient'] · ORDINAL · never a percent · never a numeric score

record_fields.name: outcome_reason
record_fields.shape: string · reconstructable from evidence · MUST NOT use forbidden vocabulary

record_fields.name: reproduction
record_fields.shape: { attempted · reproduced · attempts · seed · deterministic } · booleans + integer + seed

record_fields.name: root_cause_candidates
record_fields.shape: array of RootCauseCandidate · may be empty when outcome ∈ {NOT_REPRODUCIBLE · INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE · REPRODUCED}

record_fields.name: authoritative_top_candidate
record_fields.shape: RootCauseCandidate | null · non-null only when outcome ∈ {ROOT_CAUSE_SUPPORTED · ROOT_CAUSE_PLAUSIBLE}

record_fields.name: evidence_pool_ids
record_fields.shape: array of string · every evidence_id emitted so downstream Evidence Validation can walk the chain

record_fields.name: reproducibility_information
record_fields.shape: { command · cwd · env_fingerprint · node_version · platform · seed }

record_fields.name: limitations
record_fields.shape: string · what this session does NOT establish

record_fields.name: attribution
record_fields.shape: object · role='nex_debugger_evidence_specialist' · authority='descriptive_read_only' · produced_by='nex_debugger_evidence_specialist' · external_llm_used=false · deterministic=true · taught_by='master_ai_engineer'

invariants: Debugger MUST NOT modify · execute · merge · deploy · authorise · promote · mutate · self-modify
Debugger MUST NOT feed NEX1 directly · evidence routes through Evidence Validation → Evidence Engine → NEX2 → NEX3 → Founder → Approved Standards
Every outcome ∈ {ROOT_CAUSE_SUPPORTED · ROOT_CAUSE_PLAUSIBLE} MUST cite ≥1 SBFL evidence_id AND ≥1 AST-diff evidence_id (SUPPORTED) or at least one authoritative source (PLAUSIBLE)
ROOT_CAUSE_UNRESOLVED and NOT_REPRODUCIBLE are FIRST-CLASS SUCCESSFUL OUTCOMES · they are correct verdicts when evidence does not support a determination
confidence_class is ORDINAL · never a percent · never numeric score
Determinism · same input + same seed → identical outcome + identical reasoning body
Byte-identity witness · Debugger MUST NOT mutate the measured project files
external_llm_used MUST be false · deterministic MUST be true
authorisation and execution fields are constants · false · not runtime-modifiable
Independence Constitution compliance · Debugger identity + operation + evidence retention MUST survive removal of any local inference adapter (adapter-removal conformance test)
